name: Terbutje
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 18, Adventurer's Armory pg. 5
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 18, Adventurer's Armory pg. 5
Statistics
Cost 5 gp Weight 2 lbs.
Damage 1d6 (small), 1d8 (medium); Critical 19-20/x2; Range —; Type S; Special fragile
Category One-Handed; Proficiency Martial
Weapon Groups Blades, Heavy
Description
This Stone Age weapon, also called a macuahuitl, is made from a length of tempered wood. It has bits of shark teeth, obsidian, glass, or similar materials studded all along its length.
